notes: Two serial ranges use different display console and drive motor assemblies: 840024-841699 and 841700 and up.

gaps: No motor horsepower or voltage and no capacitor value were found.
The manual does not say in so many words that the drive motor is DC.
The drive motor sits in the large-DC-motor slot because of the template's drive motor entry, not because the manual states DC.
The transformer has no part number, so the rating is not put on the parts-list transformer.
The manual carries an FCC Part 15 notice but no FCC ID.
Where the safety power relay sits is not stated; it is filed under the motor controller board because its signal passes through the control board.
method: Source: Life Fitness Model 3500 Treadmill Service Manual (After Market Services; Internet Archive copy, titled TR3500 there), read as text on 2026-11-12.

Parts come from the Parts Identification list near the end (PDF p. 40); behaviour from Theory of Operation (PDF p. 5), the troubleshooting guide and the How To pages (heatsink control board, lift actuator, drive motor, front roller).
The parts list gives Life Fitness part numbers but no ratings.
Its leads go to a polarized capacitor, + red, - black, and the wiring diagram marks the board's motor terminals + and -.
The wiring diagram (PDF p. 39) shows 120 VAC 60 Hz line input and a transformer with a 120 VAC 60 Hz primary and a 12 VAC 1.75 A secondary.
Qty 1 on extra parts is inferred from single listings in the parts list.

comps.spec: Drive motor assembly AK40-00021-0001 (serial 840024-841699) or AK40-00051-0001 (serial 841700 and up); the speed sensor sits on the drive motor; motor leads run to a polarized capacitor (+ red, - black)

Heatsink control board assembly AK40-00033-0001: powers the treadmill and links the display console to the drive motor, lift actuator, speed sensor and lift limit switch; drive motor trigger, lift time/direction and safety power relay signals pass through it; six connectors
comps.loc: Motor pan, under the motor cover

comps.spec: Control board is supplied as a heatsink assembly (Heatsink Control Board AK40-00033-0001), screwed to the motor pan with grounding wires
Safety power relay, switched by a signal from the display console routed through the control board
Capacitor, motor (run), part 118E-00001-0056, polarized, with a red protective cap 0017-00042-0859; the drive motor leads connect to it and it is unplugged when the control board is removed
Choke, part 111E-00001-0014, connected to the control board by cable assembly AK36-00016-0000 (choke-control)
Lift actuator OK40-01018-0000 with its own built-in limit switches; a lift motor nut pins it to the lift frame, a clevis pin to the frame; plugs into the control board at P4
Home lift limit switch that tells the console the deck is at 0% incline (cable assembly home-switch AK36-00025-0000)
Speed sensor with bracket assembly AK40-00031-0000, called an opto speed sensor in the troubleshooting guide
Drive motor belt (poly-V) OK40-01014-0000 to the front roller pulley, with a belt tensioning rod OK40-01096-0000
Front roller assembly AK40-00027-0000 (with pulley) and rear roller OK40-01013-0000
